description: End-to-end workflow for submitting, moderating, and dispatching transactional or campaign emails with human/automated review, escalation, and rollback.

email_template_id.description: Unique identifier for an email template stored in the system

email_submission_id.description: Identifier for a specific email submission instance (template + recipients + content overrides)

moderation_request_id.description: Identifier for a moderation request associated with an email submission

moderation_decision_id.description: Identifier for a specific moderation decision record

dispatch_job_id.description: Identifier for a batch email dispatch job

review_comment.description: Comment left by a moderator or automated system

author_id.description: User ID for human moderators or system component ID

field.description: Field the suggestion applies to (e.g., subject, body_html, preheader)

blocking.description: If true, this suggestion must be resolved before approval

recipient_segment.description: Dynamic segment or static list definition for recipients

segment_id.description: Identifier of an existing segment for reuse

static_recipients.description: Explicit list of recipients for static lists

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value data associated with the recipient

query.description: Dynamic query definition for selecting recipients from CRM-like data

filters.description: List of filter conditions combined with the specified logical operator

limit.description: Maximum number of recipients to resolve for preview or dispatch

moderation_policy.description: Moderation policy snapshot applied to a request

actor_ref.description: Reference to the actor (human user or system) performing an action.

attachment_ref.description: Attachment reference: file or external link.

tag_filter.description: Tag-based filter with key/value match and operators.

functions.name: create_email_submission
functions.description: Create a new email submission for moderation, combining a template, content overrides, and recipient targeting.

template_id.description: Base email_template_id to use for this submission

submission_metadata.description: High-level metadata for categorizing and describing the submission

submission_name.description: Human-readable name of the campaign or transactional submission

external_reference.description: Optional external system identifier (e.g., CRM campaign id)

content_overrides.description: Optional overrides for the base template content

sender_profile_id.description: Identifier of a verified sender profile

headers.description: Custom email headers to set for this submission

placeholders_preview_data.description: Key-value pairs for rendering a preview of dynamic placeholders

schedule.description: Scheduling options for when the email can be dispatched after approval

send_at.description: Exact time to start sending when mode is scheduled

window.description: Delivery window constraints for large batches

require_human_moderation.description: If true, requires a human moderator even if automated checks pass

functions.returns: New email_submission_id with initial status and a summary of the submission.

functions.name: run_automated_moderation
functions.description: Run automated policy checks and content analysis on an email submission prior to or in parallel with human review.

requested_checks.description: List of automated checks to perform

max_runtime_ms.description: Soft limit for automated check execution time

strict_mode.description: If true, treat warnings as blocking failures

language_hint.description: Preferred language code for content analysis

functions.returns: Automated moderation report including scores, detected issues, and a preliminary pass/fail recommendation.

functions.name: create_moderation_request
functions.description: Create a human moderation request for an email submission, optionally including automated analysis results.

auto_moderation_result.description: Optional reference or payload of automated moderation results

sla.description: Service-level expectations for handling the request

functions.returns: Created moderation_request_id with queue placement, initial status, and SLA metadata.

functions.name: get_moderation_queue
functions.description: List or page through moderation requests in a given queue, with filtering and sorting options.
functions.returns: Paged list of moderation_request_id items with summary information and queue statistics.

functions.name: submit_moderation_decision
functions.description: Submit a human or system moderation decision for a specific request, including comments and requested changes.

actor_id.description: User ID or system component ID

role.description: Role of the actor, e.g., moderator, compliance_officer

comments.description: Comments explaining the decision or requested changes

requested_changes.description: High-level requested changes for the requester

functions.returns: Created moderation_decision_id, updated moderation request and email submission statuses.

functions.name: apply_content_changes_and_resubmit
functions.description: Apply content changes to an email submission based on moderation feedback and optionally resubmit for review.

source_decision_id.description: Optional reference to the moderation_decision_id that triggered the changes

content_patches.description: List of granular content patches to apply

recipients_patch.description: Optional changes to recipient segment, e.g., limit size or exclude risky segments

resubmit_for_moderation.description: If true, automatically create a new moderation request after changes

functions.returns: Updated email submission with applied changes and optionally a new moderation_request_id.

functions.name: finalize_moderation_and_schedule_dispatch
functions.description: Lock a moderated email submission and create a dispatch job according to its schedule and approval state.

require_final_approval.description: If true, enforce that the latest decision is 'approved' before scheduling

override_schedule.description: Optional override of the submission's schedule settings at dispatch time

functions.returns: Created dispatch_job_id with scheduling details and final moderation lock information.

functions.name: get_dispatch_status
functions.description: Retrieve status and metrics for a dispatch job, including per-phase progress and basic deliverability stats.
functions.returns: Dispatch job status, progress breakdown, and optional high-level metrics (sent, delivered, bounced, etc.).

functions.name: cancel_or_pause_dispatch
functions.description: Pause or cancel an in-progress or scheduled dispatch job for risk mitigation or emergency rollback.

scope.description: Optional scope for partial cancel (e.g., specific segments or domains)

effective_from.description: When the pause/cancel should take effect

functions.returns: Updated dispatch job state, including which portion (if any) was affected and an audit record reference.

functions.name: retry_failed_dispatch_portion
functions.description: Retry a subset of recipients that previously failed or bounced in a dispatch job, with optional template or sender adjustments.

retry_scope.description: Criteria for selecting which failed recipients to retry

adjustments.description: Optional adjustments to apply for the retry

sender_profile_id.description: Override sender profile for the retry

content_note.description: Short note appended to the email body indicating a retry or correction, if desired

create_new_dispatch_job.description: If true, create a new dispatch_job_id for the retry instead of reusing the existing one

functions.returns: New or updated dispatch_job_id representing the retry attempt and a summary of selected recipients.

functions.name: get_moderation_and_dispatch_timeline
functions.description: Retrieve a full audit timeline for an email submission, including moderation events and dispatch lifecycle.
functions.returns: Chronological list of events related to moderation and dispatch for the given email_submission_id, optionally with detailed payloads.

functions.name: rollback_submission_to_previous_version
functions.description: Rollback an email submission to a previous version of its content and settings, typically used after problematic moderation or dispatch outcomes.

target_version.description: Target version number to rollback to

preserve_moderation_history.description: If true, keep previous moderation artifacts but mark them as superseded

lock_after_rollback.description: If true, prevent further edits until re-moderated

create_new_moderation_request.description: If true, automatically queue the rolled-back version for moderation

functions.returns: Updated email submission state pointing to the rolled-back version and information on any new moderation request created.

functions.name: get_email_submission_overview
functions.description: Utility function to get a consolidated overview of an email submission, including current content, moderation state, and dispatch links.

recipients_preview_limit.description: Maximum number of recipients to return in preview when include contains 'recipients_preview'

functions.returns: High-level overview object containing current submission data, moderation and dispatch linkage, based on the requested includes.

functions.name: search_email_review_entities
functions.description: Faceted search across email_review entities supporting tag filters, time windows, full-text, status, and pagination.

projection.description: Optional list of fields to project in the response.

functions.returns: Paginated list of matching email_review entities, optional facet counts, and pagination cursors.

functions.name: bulk_create_email_review_records
functions.description: Bulk-create up to N email_review records in a single atomic-or-best-effort batch with per-item validation results.
functions.returns: Per-record outcome with assigned ids or validation errors, plus an overall batch summary.

functions.name: bulk_update_email_review_records
functions.description: Apply a partial update patch to many email_review records, optionally with optimistic concurrency checks.
functions.returns: Per-update result with new version ids and a count of successes/failures.

functions.name: bulk_delete_email_review_records
functions.description: Delete or soft-delete many email_review records in one call, with cascade and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Per-id deletion outcome and references to any cascaded entities.

functions.name: export_email_review_dataset
functions.description: Schedule or stream an export of email_review data to CSV/JSONL/Parquet, with field selection and filters.
functions.returns: Export job id, estimated row count, and status tracking endpoint.

functions.name: import_email_review_dataset
functions.description: Validate and import a email_review dataset from a remote URI; supports dry-run and conflict handling.

mapping.description: Source column to target field mapping.

functions.returns: Import job id, row counts (succeeded/failed/skipped), and a sample of validation errors.

functions.name: snapshot_email_review_state
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of one or more email_review entities for later restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot id, size estimate, and retention expiry timestamp.

functions.name: restore_email_review_snapshot
functions.description: Restore email_review state from a prior snapshot with dry-run preview and conflict resolution.
functions.returns: Restore plan or actual restore result with per-entity status.

functions.name: get_email_review_metrics
functions.description: Query aggregated metrics/KPIs for the email_review workflow with grouping, filters, and time ranges.
functions.returns: Time-series points per metric and group, with totals and percentiles.

functions.name: build_email_review_dashboard
functions.description: Compose a dashboard view across email_review metrics, with panels, filters, and a shareable link.
functions.returns: Dashboard id, share URL, and resolved layout metadata.

functions.name: query_email_review_audit_events
functions.description: Search the email_review audit/change log with filters across actors, actions, resources, and time windows.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events with optional before/after diffs.

functions.name: subscribe_email_review_events
functions.description: Create a webhook subscription that delivers email_review workflow events to a target URL with retries and signing.
functions.returns: Subscription id, verification challenge if applicable, and active flag.

functions.name: list_email_review_subscriptions
functions.description: List webhook subscriptions for email_review events with filters and status counts.
functions.returns: Paginated list of subscriptions with last delivery status.

functions.name: delete_email_review_subscription
functions.description: Remove a webhook subscription for email_review events.
functions.returns: Confirmation with final delivery counters.

functions.name: schedule_email_review_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring or one-off email_review job (cron/rrule/interval) with arguments and an owner.
functions.returns: Schedule id and next computed run time.

functions.name: list_email_review_schedules
functions.description: List scheduled email_review jobs with filters and pagination.
functions.returns: Paginated list of schedules with last/next run timestamps.

functions.name: cancel_email_review_schedule
functions.description: Cancel or pause a scheduled email_review job.
functions.returns: Updated schedule state.

functions.name: simulate_email_review_operation
functions.description: Run a what-if simulation of a email_review operation without committing side effects, returning predicted outcomes.
functions.returns: Predicted outcomes, side-effect summary, warnings, and policy hits.

functions.name: request_email_review_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a email_review action, routing to the right approvers and policies.
functions.returns: Approval request id, routed approver list, and SLA timer.

functions.name: decide_email_review_approval
functions.description: Record an approve/reject/abstain decision on a email_review approval request with required justification.
functions.returns: Updated approval state and downstream effects (e.g., gate releases).

functions.name: add_email_review_comment
functions.description: Add a threaded comment or annotation to any email_review entity, supporting mentions and attachments.
functions.returns: Comment id, thread id, and updated thread state.

functions.name: list_email_review_comments
functions.description: List comments/annotations attached to a email_review entity with pagination and filters.
functions.returns: Paginated comment threads with author/timestamp/mentions.

functions.name: upsert_email_review_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule controlling email_review behavior, with conditions, effects, and a priority.
functions.returns: Policy id, version, and any conflicts with existing policies.

functions.name: list_email_review_policies
functions.description: List email_review policies/rules with filters and active flags.
functions.returns: Paginated list of policies with priority and last-modified info.

functions.name: link_email_review_entities
functions.description: Create a typed relationship between two email_review-related entities (parent/child, depends_on, references).
functions.returns: Link id and a graph delta showing newly-created relationships.

functions.name: get_email_review_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency/relationship graph rooted at a email_review entity, up to N hops, with cycle detection.
functions.returns: Nodes/edges of the dependency graph and any cycles detected.

functions.name: tag_email_review_entities
functions.description: Add, remove, or replace tags on one or many email_review entities.
functions.returns: Updated tag set per entity and count of changes applied.
